title: Templates
description: Available website templates. Each template has its own init options, flags, and dedicated guide in the sidebar.

blocks.text: Templates are full Next.js 16 apps with admin portal, Prisma + MariaDB, lead capture, optional FTP uploads, and Docker Compose for local database. Pick a template in the sidebar for template-specific commands and options.

items: Flat copy into current directory (no nested template folder)
.tempjs.json version stamp and file hash baseline
Admin at /admin with ADMIN_USER / ADMIN_PASSWORD from .env
GET /api/health for DB and env checks
GETTING_STARTED.md linear checklist in the project

blocks.title: Per-template options
blocks.text: Each template defines its own init flags in templates.json (brandFields). Hotel prompts for landmark distance; real estate prompts for RERA. Add a new templates-registry.json entry plus a JSON page to document a new template.

templates.name: Hotel Website
templates.description: Resort/hotel site with rooms, gallery, facilities, reviews, and enquiry flows.

templates.name: Real Estate Website
templates.description: Property listings with slug pages, admin CRM, and new-launch badges.
